headline_zh: 固定15个B1零分中，G16和G32各12个场景采到strict-high，两组并集13个；11个GT达到strict-high的场景，两组全部找到同门槛候选。
两组都无>=.9高见证的2个场景，其GT均strict4但score只有.857625和.890610。因此按strict-high门槛，GT独有可解而两组找不到的场景为0；不能据此说GT对全部训练场景无用。
全部38组均非canonical全0，均有非零SafetyEP rawA。15个零分场景的91条采样strict-high全部rawA>0，未见好教师被本次原始优势压成负数。
候选分布仍含大量风险：零分cohort中G16有172/240个strict3未通过候选，G32有323/480个；4个高分B1对照中也有8/64和22/128个。
这更直接支持当前theta下采样好轨迹未体现在单轨B1的现象；本次0Adam，不能称训练后无法吸收，也没有证明仅SDE改ODE就是因果。

interpretations.finding: 当前IL70采样分布里已有安全高分见证，B1零分不能一律归于无好解或无优势。
interpretations.mechanism: 源W3采样候选与单轨ODE使用不同先验seed、候选数、随机步骤、BF16 batch shape；本实验没有逐项隔离。

interpretations.finding: 15个B1零分并未形成G组全零/原始优势饥饿的观察。
interpretations.limitation: 未覆盖训练全量的persistent-allfail群体；也未测参数实际PG梯度、跨场景抵消或anchor方向。

interpretations.finding: 优先研究如何将已评分strict-high采样见证迁移到真实B1，同时保高分。
interpretations.limitation: 本结果不授权并入S6、不新增teacher bank、不证明某种辅助损失能提分。

interpretations.finding: 本panel不存在GT>=.9独有、G16与G32都没有>=.9见证的例子。
interpretations.limitation: 2个无高见证case的GT仍可安全修零；.9门槛排除了这种较低EP成功轨迹。

limits: 15 failures selected from fixed TRAIN2048 plus4 deterministic high controls; not random全TRAIN or NAVTEST evaluation.
One independent private seed per G/scene; no repeated sampling or training seeds, no population uncertainty estimate.
G32 costs2x G16 candidate queries and uses a different BF16 batch kernel; neither CRN nor same-compute causal comparison.
At fixed IL70/Adam0, good sampled but bad B1 describes a present support/deployment gap, not a post-training absorption failure.
RawA signs and PG0 do not determine actual network-gradient magnitude or source-clamp/cross-scene/anchor effects.
SafetyEP can give strict-high negative relative EP credit in successful controls: this occurred here and is not unsafe positive credit.
No new model score, no NAVTEST labels, no training/official recipe/run/owner changes.

sampler.G32: one actual batch32 chain; never split into two G16 calls
sampler.seed_key: namespace,42,token,G; independent G16 and G32 groups, not common random numbers

protocol.source_probability: clamped dimension-mean W3 proxy, not full endpoint density

quality_definitions.PG0: all G saved native GPU SafetyEP rawA exactly 0; not an actual network-gradient measurement
quality_definitions.canonical_all_zero: all G original canonical scores exactly 0
quality_definitions.credit_normalization: not applied: no fabricated world8/std from this targeted probe

title: IL70真实TRAIN零分：采样支持、SafetyEP信用与单轨B1差距
